subtitle: Driver Portal
tagline: Trips, shipments and paperwork — in one place.

_notes.iconBackground: Ground for the launcher icon, splash, favicon and both store icons. The supplied mark is #285785, drawn for a light background: on the old #0F172A it measured 2.37:1 and stopped resolving as a shape at home-screen size. On this slate-50 it measures 7.19:1. Change this and you must change app.json's splash.backgroundColor and android.adaptiveIcon.backgroundColor to match.
_notes.brand/brandDeep/brandSoft: Marketing panels only — the framed screenshot backgrounds and the feature graphic. Those stay dark: the phone captures inside them are light, so a navy panel frames them well. The logo is reversed to white over these (logo-mark-light.png), never placed in its own blue.
